# Clarisco Solutions Private Limited

> Clarisco is a Blockchain, AI & IoT software development company delivering end-to-end technology solutions to startups, enterprises, and corporates globally. Founded by Priyadharshini Suriyanarayanan, the company has 12+ years of experience, 650+ product launches, and 800+ clients worldwide. Core expertise spans AI/ML, Blockchain, Web3, DeFi, NFT, Crypto Exchange, Trading Bots, Game Development, and Custom Software.

Headquarters: Plot No. 29, 30, Iswarya Nagar, Madakkulam, Tamil Nadu 625003, India
Contact: business@clarisco.com | +91 94424 30551
Founder & CEO: Priyadharshini Suriyanarayanan (12+ years in AI, Web3, enterprise software)
